sloka: एते मद्विषयस्था वै मानवाः क्षुद्भयार्दिताः ।त्वयि भुक्ते तु तृप्तास्ते भविष्यन्ति सबान्धवाः ।। ७.१८.२९ ॥
transliteration: ete madviṣayasthā vai mānavāḥ kṣudbhayārditāḥ ।tvayi bhukte tu tṛptāste bhaviṣyanti sabāndhavāḥ ।। 7.18.29 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, these humans in my realm, afflicted by the fear of hunger, will become satisfied along with their relatives when you are eaten.
